title: Remove CLEAN27 from Service Management
summary: Service Management objects are cleaned up by removing CLEAN27 code artifacts across multiple localization layers, including deprecated pages and codeunits.
key_points: Removed CLEAN27 markers and associated code from service management functionality
Deleted deprecated pages for posted service invoice and shipment updates in localized versions
Removed codeunits related to service invoice header editing in Spanish and Italian localizations
Cleaned up page extensions and report modifications that contained CLEAN27 logic
Applied cleanup across W1 (worldwide), ES (Spain), IT (Italy), NA (North America), BE (Belgium), CH (Switzerland), FI (Finland), GB (Great Britain), and NO (Norway) layers
